name: spaces
label: Spaces
description: Run whole machines on a Leo hub — install the hypervisor, create Windows and Linux guests, and hand one a GPU.
details: Turns a Leo hub or compute machine into a hypervisor, then runs guests on it. The Host setup tab reports what the box is — distribution, CPU, IOMMU, graphics devices, whether anything can be isolated for a guest — and derives the remaining steps fresh on every load, so a step that became true disappears. Guests are KVM/QEMU domains managed through libvirt: define one, start it, snapshot it, assign it a GPU exclusively. Windows guests get UEFI firmware, a software TPM and the virtio driver ISO without being asked, because all three are what a Windows install needs and the failures when they are missing look like broken storage. Everything privileged goes through one root-owned wrapper with a closed verb set; without it this package still reports and plans, and hands over the exact commands.
setup_hint: Install it on the box you want to virtualise on and leave the host field blank. Then run scripts/install-admin-wrapper.sh once as root to let it apply its own setup steps.
use_cases: Turn the work hub into a hypervisor without a console
Run Windows-only CAD and simulation software on Linux metal
Give one guest the GPU outright, and see why another cannot have it
Snapshot a machine before letting an agent loose on it
